answer: Each identity binds to a library card, issued in person with address proof at a Willow Branch library, hashed into the Haven Registry, with a 25 POA bond locked 90 days. The bond doubles per extra card from one cluster (25/50/100/200, capped 800 POA), and libraries cap 2 cards per address, so 100 fakes need 50 addresses and lock 76,775 POA versus 25 POA honest. Each card needs a 90-day voyage log of 6 checkouts; renewal is in person within 30 days, and two misses forfeit half the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs. Shelter-address cards with double bond and check-in cover the homeless.
